title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode6 Let's Make It Together!

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, let's start streaming.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for tuning into our stream today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is an “emergency stream”, and as such, we have a special announcement in store for you today!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A special announcement? Tell us!>
<Does this mean you're doing an event?!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We'll be holding a real-life event, which means we'll finally get to meet all of you.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<No waaaay!! Really?!>
<I'm for sure going!!>
<Yaaay!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're all so excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'll be taking place on the fourth Saturday of next month starting at 4:00 pm at the Okuyama Building's basement hall in Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We apologize for not letting you know sooner, but we managed to book a venue just in time for Christmas.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll also be doing a stream on Christmas Day too!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A Christmas event!>
<I get to meet Shizuku on Christmas.>
<I'll be there, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Stay tuned and get ready for a great event, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's also something we'd like to ask of you today...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Ask us? What could it be?>
<I'll do anything! Just ask!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we have a venue and date set, but we're still shorthanded in terms of staff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If our current situation holds, we'll have to limit the number of people that can attend our event or possibly cancel it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we want as many people to come to our event as possible. We want you all to be there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If any of you out there would like to join us as staff, we'd really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What?! Us?!>
<So MMJ's recruiting event staff?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you all want to enjoy this event as fans instead of staff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we understand that we'd be asking quite a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But as it happens, someone reached out to us when we really didn't know what to do. They offered to help us with this event...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, which is why we'd like to ask you as well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If there are any others out there who feel the same way, we'd really appreciate you lending us a hand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, you won't be able to enjoy the event as part of the crowd and we don't have much to offer in terms of compensation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if that's okay with any of you out there, we beg you! Please, help us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: P-Please...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to build this event from the ground up with you guys, and I think it'll be amazing to feel that sense of accomplishment together after it succeeds!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Before, when I used to watch these kinds of events on TV or as part of the audience, I always thought about doing something like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So please, help us!!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I want to help.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm in a theatre company, so I can help with the lights a little!>
<Where do I sign up?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna help but I live too far away!>
<I'm so jealous of the people who can go!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
I'm speechless.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll attach an application for participating as event staff to this video's description later! Please take a look when you get a chance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I think it'll be a wonderful event if we all work together on it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I don't think it... I KNOW it! So let's make it an unforgettable event!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There, everything's set...
Let's start our video conference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for showing up today. Again, we apologize for asking you on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But let's do our best to make this event a success!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: <Thank you for having us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, all these people came without hesitation... I already see twenty right here...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like you were right, Minori. There were a ton of people out there willing to help us with this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Airi, the volume for the conference seems a bit low. Mind if I turn it up a little?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: S-Stop right there! I'll take care of that! You're not touching anything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Shall we start by discussing what we'll be doing for this event and how to divide up roles?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds good.
About what we'll be doing for this event...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since we're doing a Christmas event, it'll be good to decorate the stage to really give it some Christmas spirit!

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: <What if we also decorated the reception table? I really like mini-Christmas trees and have a whole collection of them!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds lovely.
I think I'll bring some ornaments from home too.

rows.Speaker: Fan B
rows.Line: <Are we allowed to use everything the venue has? That might change how many decorations we can string up based on what they let us do...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <We can use everything that's on this list, and I plan to bring in some of my own stuff as well!>

rows.Speaker: Fan B
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
That means we should be able to hang quite a lot up on the stage's back wall.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a great idea.
We should be able to put together a beautiful backdrop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is incredible...! It feels like our event's really going to succeed now because of our fans!)
The day of the event
Shibuya Okuyama Building - Basement Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's our event venue...!
It looks so much bigger than the photos online!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, quite a bit bigger.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's start by going over the schedule again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our morning will consist of the staff and us setting everything up, and do a rehearsal in the afternoon. The doors will open at 3:00 pm and the show will start at 4:00 pm.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good!
Did you get a chance to warm up your voice before you got here, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Eep!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You'll be fine.
Just do what you usually do, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Thanks, Shizuku!

Good morning!
Looks like everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, Saito, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good morning.
This feels so strange. It's our first time meeting in real life even though we've met previously online...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ah, my goddess...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Goddess?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: P-Pardon me! It's just, I've always been a fan of yours, Shizuku, and I never imagined being able to talk to you up close like this...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's just something about you and eccentric fans...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for being such an avid supporter. I look forward to working with you today, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: L-Likewise...!!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Phew... Pardon my indiscretion.
I promise to do my best to lead everyone today and not let my personal business get in the way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Now, why don't we go meet the other staff members? You said we have 26 in total today, right, Saito?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, there's one more coming in the afternoon based on what they said on their application form!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: They're busy in the morning but really wanted to participate as staff at least in the afternoon if possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's great!
It's so nice to hear that they're so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we should also do our best to meet their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's head over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(It's really about to start.
Our very own event as MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I have to give it everything I've got!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank for you joining us today, everyone.
Let's all put our best foot forward today!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Let's start by getting everything set up!
You all probably know that this won't be easy, so please be sure to lend each other a hand whenever possible.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: We'll now split into our roles as we've discussed, starting with the reception group and the stage group.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: <Thank you for having us!>
